name: 46819 · Fort Wayne, IN
findings: ZIP 46819 (Fort Wayne) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46819 (Fort Wayne) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 46819 (Fort Wayne) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
